primary_scientific_question: Does adjacency-aware graph learning outperform an information-matched topology-free neural representation?
information_deliberately_removed: passer identity for each pass event
recipient identity for each pass event
fusion: exact static sigmoid-constrained scalar logit fusion
multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the three Experiment 6 McNemar tests

interpretation_rules.graph_supported: If adjacency-aware model advantage has paired CI above zero, report evidence for graph-specific benefit.
interpretation_rules.graph_inconclusive: If point estimate favors graph model but CI crosses zero, report suggestive but unestablished graph-specific benefit.
interpretation_rules.no_graph_requirement: If topology-free and graph models are similar, conclude rich completed-match information is useful but graph learning is not shown to be necessary.
interpretation_rules.topology_free_better: If topology-free model performs better, report it without rerunning to obtain a preferred result.
